summary_1line: Dhritarashtra laments Bhishma’s fall and questions Sanjaya, who explains fate, his divine vision, and Duryodhana’s strategy to protect Bhishma from Shikhandin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dhritarashtra imagines the battlefield as a terrible dice-board where men, elephants, and horses are the pieces and warriors gamble with their lives.
Duryodhana urgently commands Dussasana to surround and guard the aged Bhishma while warriors prepare to kill Shikhandin.
Sanjaya bows to Vyasa and describes the divine sight that lets him see distant battles and know the hearts of warriors.
